subject: Save the summary of the parameters

messages.author: f11b52e0e4d4a168
messages.subject: Save the summary of the parameters
parts:
In Rstan,  print  are defined to work with the samples, conduct model inference, and assess the convergence of the Markov chains. But, print can't save the results into a matrix table. Now, I'm using coda package to get the posterior mean, sd, R hat, and effective size. Does Rstan has the default function to do this job?

Thanks

> If you report a potential bug, it really helps us debug it

>
> Just saying it doesn't work doesn't give us much to go on.

Bob, summary works but ends with "invisible(ss)", so if you type:

> summary(sf)

it looks like as if it returns nothing.
I don't like those "invisible" (a matter of taste), but

> print(summary(sf))

or

> something <- summary(sf)
> str(summary)

work very well.

Cheers

Sergio
